items.q: If Hormozi started today, what would he cut first?
items.a: Self-help fog. Get clear on **observable actions**. Business is attract → convert → deliver with **positive unit economics**. Useful metric: **money per unit of time**, not a fake active/passive binary.

items.q: Why do beginners hop instead of earning?
items.a: Five stages: uninformed optimism → informed pessimism → **valley of despair** → informed optimism → achievement. Stay in the painful middle long enough to pay the **ignorance tax**. Investing/speculation is **last**; make **active income** cool again.

items.q: What three myths does he attack?
items.a: **Investing-first / get-rich-quick**, **follow your passion** (passions change; markets may not care), and **idea > execution**. Four steps tomorrow: LLC, bank, payment processor, **ask a stranger for money**.

items.q: How does free work become a business?
items.a: Bootstrap demand with **free/testimonial** work, then raise price **~20% every five clients**. Testimonials beat early cash. Fear shrinks when made **specific** (dinner, bed, Sarah's couch). Final Five: unreasonable volume; don't follow passion; help up; focus; **give wealth away at death**.
